rule: From `diagnostic`, an encoder produces exactly `pdu_hex`, framed as `frame_hex` (two bytes of length, big-endian). Every `invalid` frame is answered with ERROR `malformed` (RP-3 §2).

pdus.name: HELLO, unsigned (the client's clock is wrong)
WELCOME from a station called directly, with its proof
MSG, first piece of a 6 kB message
RECEIPT with a partial and a failure
ERROR, fatal
pdus.diagnostic: {0: 8, 1: 5, 2: "Your credential was revoked by radiopost.org.", 4: true}

pdus.name: ERROR about one message, not fatal
NOTICE
pdus.diagnostic: {0: 10, 1: "Internet down here since 14:10; your mail waits in my queue."}

invalid.why: a PDU of an unknown type (99)
a PDU that is not deterministic CBOR
